newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 19.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - High-income earners also will be eligible for tax rebate, finance ministry says.
Control yuan will investigate Chinese Petroleum Corp explosion that killed one person.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Final goal of educational reforms is to have students apply directly to colleges.
Several Taiwan officials fail to obtain visas to Hong Kong due to pressure from communist China.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - High-level officials of Chinese Petroleum Corp will be punished after fatal explosion.
Up to 7,000 cars from South Korea will be imported to Taiwan next month.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Stock market index sets new year high.
Between 25 to 50 people's representatives in central government are tainted with gangster background.
